svg.title: How much BMI fell in pediatric trials
svg.desc: How much BMI fell in pediatric trials. STEP TEENS: Wegovy, ages 12-17, 68 wk: placebo +0.6%, drug -16.1%. SURPASS-PEDS: tirzepatide 5 mg, ages 10-17 with T2D, 30 wk: placebo -0.4%, drug -7.4%. SURPASS-PEDS: tirzepatide 10 mg, ages 10-17 with T2D, 30 wk: placebo -0.4%, drug -11.2%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
